A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same NDM research work. All 47 pages of each version, including Appendices A-I, are available and readable; text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original toy-model experiments, GPT-2 circuit evaluations in Table 1, and knowledge-conflict experiments on Qwen2.5-1.5B and Gemma-2-2B in Figure 5, with further appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including the quantitative evaluations, qualitative subspace analyses, and supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3, Algorithm 1, and the appendices retain the same NDM objective, orthogonal optimization, MI-based merging, toy-setting variant, and alternative procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic feature-group tasks, MiniPile and OpenWebText data, GPT-2 IOI and Greater-than tests, and RAVEL Nobel-prize knowledge-conflict scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Identity, Random, PCA 1, PCA 2, and the SAE-derived Feature baseline. Appendix F.2 and Figures 19-20 retain their respective comparison methods and configurations.

E3.justification: The training settings, model layers, sample counts, patching controls, and evaluation metrics are unchanged, including the 1,000 examples per GPT-2 test described in Appendix D.2.

E4.justification: The toy analyses, hyperparameter and data-source ablations in Appendix D.5, qualitative cases in Appendix E, and alternative-approach experiments in Appendix G.4 are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain the same point-estimate reporting and averaging over evaluation examples. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-interval, or significance-test information is added, removed, or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results match throughout. For example, Table 1 retains average Gini coefficients of 0.71 for NDM and 0.56 for Feature; appendix tables and plotted findings also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1-16 and their mathematical reasoning are unchanged, including the total-correlation argument in Appendix B.1 and minimax formulations in Appendix G.4. Equation 6 is relocated without modification.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about unsupervised interpretable subspaces, alignment with GPT-2 circuit variables, applicability to approximately 2B models, and potential subspace circuits.

C2.justification: Mechanism interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including unclear subspace meanings, orthogonality and linear-representation assumptions, computational constraints, and caveats about unknown knowledge-routing circuits.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters, activation-database construction, attribution details, H100 training times, and code/trained-matrix access information are unchanged. The expanded funding acknowledgment adds no technical reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. References move across page boundaries, but no related work or novelty argument is added or removed.

P1.justification: The acknowledgments on page 10 add GRK 2853/1 funding/environment recognition and thanks to anonymous reviewers. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; scientific prose, terminology, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Pagination and float placement shift: Table 7 moves from page 28 to 29, Figure 32 from 40 to 41, and Table 8 from 43 to 44. Their content, captions, and visual design remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 expands acknowledgments and reflows existing material, while retaining the same methods, evidence, explanations, reproducibility details, and limitations throughout the main text and appendices. These editorial changes do not materially improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
